subject.name: JANUS Proof Search Laboratory / Janus-Fundamentum
subject.repository_policy_for_this_registry: READ_ONLY_SOURCE; no source files modified by this portfolio snapshot
subject.research_role: proof-carrying adversarial research laboratory for computational-complexity hypotheses

public_evidence.method_motto: Generate hypotheses. Attack them. Preserve survivors. Never confuse survival with proof.

methodological_contribution.hypothesis_graph: Each new hypothesis has an explicit proof role, parent lineage, next gate and attack obligations.
methodological_contribution.proof_carrying_artifacts: Computational claims are bound to committed code, fixed inputs, expected outputs, hashes and machine-readable certificates.
methodological_contribution.independent_replay: Verifiers independently reconstruct/recompute critical claims rather than merely trusting producer fields.
methodological_contribution.tamper_rejection: Declared adversarial mutations are required to fail with explicit error classes.
methodological_contribution.negative_results_first_class: Falsified routes, failed refinements and counterexamples are preserved instead of silently removed.
methodological_contribution.frozen_audit: Inputs, branch subjects, workflow contracts, workload counts and terminal boundaries are frozen before promotion.
methodological_contribution.claim_lattice: Candidate, executable draft, candidate complete, admitted and terminal states are separated; pressure or scale cannot promote an unresolved result.
methodological_contribution.anti_cargo_cult_rule: Finite exhaustive evidence is never promoted to an arbitrary-n theorem without a separate proof.

c024.lesson: A graph-theoretic abstraction was explicitly rejected when exhaustive counterexamples showed that proof provenance/history could not be discarded.

current_node9_line.interpretation: The current draft compresses a very large fine domain into auditable structural quotient domains while explicitly refusing to infer success/failure before witnesses and independent verification.

what_is_distinctive.known_prior_art: Automated theorem proving, proof assistants, AI hypothesis generation, falsification, property-based testing, proof certificates and reproducible CI all have extensive prior art.
what_is_distinctive.candidate_delta: A public research workflow that treats the evolving proof attempt itself as a proof-carrying adversarial organism: machine-readable hypothesis lineage, frozen audits, independent replay, explicit tamper matrix, preserved negative results and non-promotable OPEN/BLOCKED states.
what_is_distinctive.scientific_value: The methodology can produce a useful research record even when the target theorem remains open because it documents exactly which routes failed, which lemmas are proved, and which assumptions remain unclosed.

novelty_assessment.candidate_claim: Proof-carrying adversarial research methodology for AI-assisted mathematical exploration with explicit lineage, replay, tamper and negative-result preservation.

safe_public_claims.short: I built JANUS Proof Search Laboratory, a public proof-carrying research environment where hypotheses are attacked, negative results are preserved, certificates are independently replayed and no result is promoted beyond its verified gate.
safe_public_claims.technical: The laboratory combines machine-readable hypothesis lineage, frozen audits, exact workload conservation, independent certificate replay, tamper rejection and strict candidate/admission boundaries in an ongoing computational-complexity research program.
do_not_claim: a finite computation proves an arbitrary-n theorem unless separately proved
all methodology components are individually new
